Ministry of Civil Aviation Invites Applications for Airports Authority of India Member (Operations) Post

29 Oct 2026, 01:37 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Careers Desk · Source: www.freejobalert.com

Image: www.freejobalert.com — Creative Commons

Key takeawaysThe Ministry of Civil Aviation, Government of India, has issued an official notification inviting offline applications for the post of Member (Operations) in the Airports Authority of India (AAI) under Advertisement No. 01/2026. Eligible candidates from eligible public

The Ministry of Civil Aviation, Government of India, has issued an official notification inviting offline applications for the post of Member (Operations) in the Airports Authority of India (AAI) under Advertisement No. 01/2026. Eligible candidates from eligible public and private sectors must submit their applications by November 23, 2026, at 5:00 PM.

Role and Background

The Airports Authority of India operates as a Schedule 'A' / Miniratna (Category-1) Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) under the administrative jurisdiction of the Ministry of Civil Aviation, headquartered in New Delhi. The Member (Operations) position serves as a member of the Board of Directors, reporting directly to the Chairperson of AAI. Responsibilities for the role encompass airport management, IT services, infrastructure upkeep, safety and rescue services, security, coordination, and promoting indigenization under the Atma Nirbhar Scheme.

Compensation and Tenure

The selected candidate will be placed in the Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) pay scale of Rs. 1,80,000 to Rs. 3,40,000. The appointment carries a tenure of five years from the date of joining or up to the date of superannuation (age 60), whichever is earlier. Central Government officers, Armed Forces personnel, All India Services officers, and personnel from Public Sector Banks, Financial Institutions, and Autonomous Bodies will be considered strictly on an immediate absorption basis. No application fee is specified in the official notification.

Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must meet specific age, employment, qualification, and experience standards:

  • Age Limit: Candidates must be at least 45 years of age with a minimum residual service of three years as of the date of advertisement, referencing the superannuation age of 60.
  • Employment Status: Applicants must be employed in a regular capacity within a CPSE, Central Government Group 'A' service (including Armed Services and All India Services), Public Sector Bank, Financial Institution, Autonomous Body, State PSE with an annual turnover of Rs. 2,000 crore or more, or a Private Sector Company/JV/Federation meeting the same turnover threshold.
  • Educational Qualification: An Engineering Graduate or Science Graduate with a good academic record from a recognized university or institute. An MBA qualification is listed as a desirable asset providing an added advantage.
  • Experience: A minimum of 10 years of experience at a senior management level in technical, operational, large-scale infrastructure management, and/or logistics functions in an organization of repute. Experience of 5 years in the aviation sector during the last 10 years is preferred.

Application Procedure and Selection Process

Applicants must download the prescribed application format from the Ministry of Civil Aviation website, complete the form, attach a passport-size photograph, and provide self-attested copies of documents supporting age, qualifications, and experience. Private sector applicants must also include annual reports for the three financial years preceding the calendar year, documentary proof of the company being listed or unlisted, and evidence of working at the board level or immediately below.

Applications must be routed through the proper channel based on employment status, while private sector candidates may submit directly. Completed applications must reach the designated authority by post or hand delivery on or before November 23, 2026 (05:00 PM). Nodal officers have until December 3, 2026 (05:00 PM) to forward applications.

Submission Address: Under Secretary, Airport Authority of India Section, Ministry of Civil Aviation, Room No. 50, ‘B’ Block, Rajiv Gandhi Bhawan, Safdarjung Airport, New Delhi-110003.

The selection process consists of an initial shortlisting of applicants by the Ministry of Civil Aviation followed by an interview. Candidates should note that withdrawing willingness after the interview or after receiving an offer will result in a two-year debarment from board-level posts in any CPSE.

Practical Implications and Verification

Readers should carefully verify all guidelines, format requirements, and submission channels directly through the official announcement.

  • Confirmed Details: Employer (AAI / Ministry of Civil Aviation), Role (Member Operations), Pay Scale (Rs. 1,80,000 – 3,40,000), Application Deadline (November 23, 2026, 05:00 PM), Location (New Delhi), and Selection Method (Shortlisting and Interview).
  • Unknown/Unspecified Details: The exact total vacancy count is not explicitly detailed in the summary text beyond the single position context, and no application fee is noted.
  • Verification: Review the complete notification guidelines and download application forms via the [Official Source URL](https://www.freejobalert.com/articles/aai-member-operations-recruitment-2026-3076007).
